The application includes the Chinese vocabulary from hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large.
The vocabulary is distributed under the Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE.txt.

The optional CSI speaker-identification checkpoint remains a user-imported model.
Its upstream project labels the CSI corpus for non-commercial research use.

Role inference uses the HarmonyOS system MindSpore Lite runtime.
A portable MindIR Lite model serves both NNRT acceleration and CPU execution.
The application selects the accelerator by capability and uses CPU support for
the remaining operators. Model conversion uses MindSpore Lite 2.7.0 general
graph optimization. MindSpore is distributed under the Apache License 2.0.
